clips.title: The story
paras: This quest is the final reckoning with Morbent Fel, the necromancer haunting the heights above Raven Hill Cemetery. Armed with the enchanted relic Morbent's Bane, heroes are sent by the grieving Sven Yorgen to shatter the sorcerer's wards and end his reign of terror over western Duskwood.

Morbent Fel makes his lair in an abandoned house perched atop a rocky ridge just east of Sven's camp, overlooking the sprawl of Raven Hill Cemetery. From this grim vantage, the necromancer has directed waves of undead to terrorize the surrounding forest and defile the graves of Duskwood. Protected by formidable dark magic and attended by loyal undead thralls, he has remained untouchable to ordinary steel.

Direct assault against Morbent Fel is suicide without supernatural aid; his defensive sorceries deflect conventional attacks. To bypass these wards, Sven entrusts adventurers with Morbent's Bane, an enchanted artifact designed specifically to unravel the necromancer's magical shielding. Once invoked, the barrier collapses, leaving Fel vulnerable to a mortal strike.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery. His time in this land is drawing to an end...
Use Morbent's Bane against him. It will render his protective magics powerless.
Slay him. Slay him, and save us from his wickedness. Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Morbent Fel has been defeated. The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.
You have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of Duskwood.
Go, friend. And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...
